newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes slightly lower.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index closed lower on Friday despite a major issue rebound spearheaded by Komercni Banka.
The PX50 closed down 0.6 point at 504.1 while the major-issue-dominated rose six to 1,032.
Komercni Banka, which on Friday released nine-month financial results, rose 126 crowns to 2,126.

The bank posted nine-month net profits of 4.8 billion crowns, compared with 5.4 billion in the same period in 1995. Dealers said the results were as expected and reflected changes in company accounting procedures rather than fundamentals.
SPT Telecom, which along with Komercni had been one of the most prolific decliners of the week, also moved higher. SPT rose six crowns to 2,885.
